summary: Lockfile-only change to packages/eql/Cargo.lock: reqwest 0.13.3 -> 0.13.4 pulls hickory-resolver/hickory-proto 0.25.2 -> 0.26.3 (new hickory-net crate, prefix-trie, system-configuration, ndk-context; enum-as-inner dropped) to pick up two security advisories, and re-resolves several Windows-only windows-sys edges to older versions. No Cargo.toml changed. The only path to reqwest/hickory from a workspace member is the unpublished eql_tests crate (publish = false) via cipherstash-client and stack-auth; the published eql-bindings crate and the SQL bundle do not depend on any changed package, and a library's Cargo.lock is not used by downstream consumers. The realistic failure is a loud one: the CI SQLx/e2e suite, which reaches ZeroKMS through cipherstash-client and so through the new DNS resolver, fails or flakes. test-eql.yml is path-triggered on Cargo.lock, so it should run on this change, but no CI result was supplied. Impact low; ready for normal review once CI is green.

behaviour_changes.description: The DNS resolver used by reqwest in the eql workspace moves from hickory-resolver/hickory-proto 0.25.2 to 0.26.3 (a 0.x minor bump, i.e. a semver-breaking range upstream), with networking split into a new hickory-net crate and new transitive deps (prefix-trie, system-configuration, ndk-context). This changes how cipherstash-client/stack-auth resolve hostnames inside the eql_tests harness.

Several crates' windows-sys edges are re-resolved to older versions (errno, quinn-udp, rustix 1.1.4, rustls-platform-verifier, tempfile -> 0.59.0; winapi-util -> 0.48.0) and core-foundation 0.9.4 is added for system-configuration. These only compile on Windows/macOS targets respectively.
No manifest, source, SQL or workflow file changes; published artefacts built from packages/eql (eql-bindings crate, SQL bundle) do not include any changed package.

failure_scenarios.title: EQL SQLx/e2e CI fails or flakes because the test harness's ZeroKMS client resolves DNS differently
failure_scenarios.trigger: CI runs the eql_tests e2e/fixture suite, which builds cipherstash-client/stack-auth against reqwest 0.13.4 + hickory-resolver 0.26.3 and makes network calls to ZeroKMS.
failure_scenarios.mechanism: hickory-resolver 0.26 is a breaking-range upgrade (new hickory-net crate, changed system-configuration handling). If its system resolver configuration handling or defaults differ on the CI runner, reqwest's lookups for ZeroKMS endpoints could fail or time out.
failure_scenarios.consequence: Loud failure: the eql test job fails or is flaky, blocking merges for EQL changes until reverted or fixed. No customer-facing artefact is affected because eql_tests is publish = false and the published crate and SQL do not contain these packages.
